items.rationale: Insured event under 2.6.2/2.6.4; battery waiver disapplies 2.6.8. Repair uneconomic per supplier report, so 7.1.10 replacement amount for an equivalent laptop applies; no deductible or sub-limit is stated.
7.1.9 bars betterment: the upgrade difference is borne by the policyholder.
Second unit struck in the same event (2.6.4) with a cracked screen (2.6.3(a)), so the repair cost is covered.
5.2.3 covers examination of each affected unit, including where repair proves uneconomic, capped at EUR 250 per event; the reference price level (Case 22) suggests a lower actual charge.
4.2.6 and 7.1.5: a carrying case not itself damaged by the event is not indemnified.
Excluded by 3.5(f), 4.3(f) and 7.1.8(e) as an undertaking as to future performance.
3.5(d) excludes data recovery unless agreed under 4.3(c); no such agreement is shown in the schedule.
7.1.8(b) excludes administrative charges, and this line type was never indemnified in earlier cases.
